issue.title: test_usage_config.py: 6 tests assert stable usage-window key order, actual order flipped
issue.description: Discovered while verifying an unrelated continuation_budget.py module split (task: splitting src/sase/llm_provider/continuation_budget.py into smaller files). tests/llm_provider/test_usage_config.py has 6 deterministically failing tests asserting a specific tuple order of projected usage-window keys, e.g. expecting ("session-low", "weekly") but getting ("weekly", "session-low"). Reproduced on unmodified master at 4cd297ada2cabb839a5a189946575e5e03007d38 (confirmed via git stash -- my own working tree changes only touch src/sase/llm_provider/continuation_budget*.py and its tests, nothing in llm_provider/config.py or usage_config), and persists after a fresh 'just install' in this ephemeral workspace, ruling out stale-venv drift. Failing tests: test_usage_indicator_defaults_and_overrides, test_usage_indicator_real_bundled_default_and_user_override_projection[empty-provider-map-keeps-bundled-exact-window], [exact-key-never-wins], [exact-key-threshold-restores-generic-boundary], [unrelated-provider-override-keeps-claude-defaults], and test_usage_indicator_bundled_fable_default_does_not_synthesize_missing_window. Looks like a dict/set ordering assumption in the window-projection code (src/sase/llm_provider likely usage_config.py or similar) that no longer holds -- worth checking whether iteration order of window definitions changed (e.g. a dict->set conversion, or an unordered merge of provider/model config layers).

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: Reproduces on every run, including a fresh checkout at master HEAD (4cd297ada2) with no working-tree changes and after a clean 'just install' -- not intermittent.
